integrity: The local covariance is derived by an involution that swaps two images and by an exact count of whether the two positions belong to the same cycle after two images are prescribed. The total covariance is an exact sum over positional gaps. The correlation uses standard cycle-count and Lehmer-code variance formulas, each also replayed computationally.
scientific_limitations: The covariance and derivative are evaluated at the uniform Mallows point q=1; no global formula in q is claimed.
The inversion statistic is the ordinary one-line inversion count, not an inversion statistic formed from standardized cycle notation.
Older enumerative permutation literature may contain an equivalent mixed first moment under another encoding.
title: Linear inversion-gap profile for cycle count in a uniform random permutation
